title: Manager prep - Q1 2026 performance notes
content:
Purpose: quick manager prep notes and self-review bullets for the upcoming Q1 check-in. This is a working scratchpad - will tidy into the formal review doc after 1:1.

TL;DR:
- Overall feel: positive momentum. Took ownership of two cross-functional initiatives (onboarding revamp, hiring calibration) that reduced time-to-onboard and improved hiring consistency.
- Key ask: discuss readiness for Senior People Ops (IC3) responsibilities and potential comp calibration; propose expanding remit to include 2 more product teams for onboarding programs.

Accomplishments (Q1 highlights):
- Onboarding revamp pilot (Feb): led project with Eng + Product to shorten initial ramp by ~25% in pilot cohort. Built a new mentor pairing framework + onboarding checklist. Draft metrics: cohort ramp median time 6 weeks -> 4.5 weeks (pilot n=12).
- Interview calibration program: designed and ran 3 calibration sessions with hiring managers across Eng, Product, and Console teams. Result: 18% reduction in post-offer rescinds attributed to mismatch in expectations (anecdotal but supported by manager feedback).
- Ops automation: implemented a simple Airtable -> HRIS sync for contractor renewals (saved ~4 hrs/wk for people ops team; fewer missed renewals).
- Cross-functional enablement: created two training decks (onboarding 101, inclusive interviewing) and delivered 4 sessions (avg NPS 4.3/5).

Impact & metrics to highlight:
- Onboarding pilot: median ramp time down 25% (pilot cohort); mentor survey 4.2/5.
- Interview quality: calibration sessions led to more consistent score distribution across interviewers (internal metric: standard deviation of interviewer scores decreased by ~0.4 points).
- Time savings: contractor renewal automation ~4 hours/week reclaimed.
- Stakeholder satisfaction: direct manager + two hiring managers gave positive qualitative feedback for project ownership.

Challenges / missed things:
- Pilot scale: still early-stage - need to validate across more teams to be confident about lift across company.
- Data collection gaps: onboarding success metric (time-to-productivity) requires tighter instrumentation in product usage funnels; need eng support.
- Bandwidth: balancing execution vs. strategic projects; felt reactive during a few weeks because of hiring volume spikes.

Development goals (next 6 months):
- Scale onboarding revamp to 3 additional teams (Console, Dedicated, Optimize). Aim for company-wide rollout and measurable ramp improvements.
- Strengthen data partnership with product analytics: instrument 2 key onboarding events and get weekly dashboards.
- Leadership: take on mentorship of a junior POps associate and run manager-of-managers training module when we hire an additional manager.

Asks for manager / topics to discuss:
- Title / level calibration: I feel I'm operating at Senior People Ops scope (IC3) on delivery + cross-functional influence. Would like feedback on readiness and what gaps remain.
- Compensation check: can we review market comp for IC3 in current band and potential timing for calibration?
- Headcount prioritization: ask to own onboarding for +2 product teams - need clarity on hiring priority and budget.
- Support for analytics: ask for a short-term allocation of 0.1 FTE from Eng Analytics to help instrument onboarding metrics (2 sprints).

Potential risks / notes for calibration meeting:
- If title level is delayed, risk of attrition for me in ~6-9 months (documented interest in growth opportunities).
- If automation rollout is deprioritized, time savings and reduced manual error risk will be lost.

Conversation prompts (for 1:1):
- What would you need to see (3 concrete signals) to promote to IC3? Examples: consistent cross-functional project outcomes, mentorship evidence, measurable process improvements.
- Is there a preferred timeline for comp calibration this year given budget cycles?
- Are there stakeholders I should loop in to help scale onboarding (specific Eng leads, product managers)?

Notes / anecdotes to mention briefly:
- Hiring manager from Console said: "Onboarding pilot made first 90 days feel purposeful - new hires are able to contribute faster."
- Mentor feedback: two mentors reported the checklist reduced time spent answering the same questions by ~30%.
- Candidate experience: updated offer packet + onboarding note decreased first-week confusion (qualitative).

Next steps after 1:1:
- Convert to formal self-review doc and add to performance packet (link to be added).
- Follow up on analytics FTE ask and draft a short project plan (2 sprints) to instrument onboarding metrics.
- Draft a promotion readiness checklist and map to the three signals asked by manager.

Quick TODOs (scratch):
- [ ] Add concrete numbers from HRIS for contractor renewals (Feb data).
- [ ] Pull mentor survey raw responses and attach (Confluence-1234).
- [ ] Schedule calibration follow-up with Eng analytics (email Alex).
- [ ] Finish formal self-review doc by 2026-03-05.

This is informal - will prune and formalize.
